title: RFC 3977 conformance: session init, CAPABILITIES, MODE READER
description:
Test: connect to reader, verify greeting is 200 or 201. Send CAPABILITIES, verify VERSION 2 is present. Send MODE READER, verify 200. Send QUIT, verify 205. Test each with three clients: raw telnet (via Python socket), slrn, tin. Artifact: tests/conformance/session_init.py.

Acceptance criteria:
- 200/201 greeting contains server name
- CAPABILITIES includes VERSION 2
- MODE READER returns 200 (not 201, not 400)
- QUIT returns 205 and closes connection
- All three client methods pass
